name: kiaaccess-mcp
description: Kia Access vehicle tools — status, location, doors, climate, and charging
long_description: Talks to the Kia Owners API the Kia Access mobile app uses, authenticating with your own Kia account email and password. Read tools cover the vehicle list, cached and force-refreshed status, location, odometer, and EV charge state. Every command that acts on the vehicle — door lock/unlock, climate start/stop, charge start/stop, charge limits — is confirmation-gated: it asks you to confirm first — with a confirmation prompt where the client supports one, otherwise the first call makes no network call and returns a preview of exactly what would be sent plus a one-time confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

tools.name: kia_healthcheck
tools.description: Check Kia credentials and session, then probe the API by listing vehicles

tools.name: kia_session_status
tools.description: Show whether a Kia session is bootstrapped and which write mode is active (no network call, no secrets)

tools.name: kia_start_login
tools.description: Start the Kia MFA login bootstrap (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: kia_send_otp
tools.description: Send the Kia one-time passcode by SMS or email

tools.name: kia_verify_otp
tools.description: Verify the Kia one-time passcode and store the session

tools.name: kia_forget_session
tools.description: Discard the stored Kia session so login can be re-run (local only, confirmation-gated)

tools.name: kia_export_refresh_token
tools.description: Export the stored Kia refresh token in plaintext for KIA_RMTOKEN (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: kia_list_vehicles
tools.description: List enrolled Kia vehicles with their vehicle keys, nicknames, models and mileage

tools.name: kia_vehicle_status
tools.description: Read a vehicle's cached status: doors, ignition, climate, EV battery and more

tools.name: kia_refresh_status
tools.description: Wake the vehicle's telematics unit for a fresh status reading (slow, draws power)

tools.name: kia_vehicle_location
tools.description: Read the vehicle's last reported location with a map link

tools.name: kia_charge_targets
tools.description: Read the EV target state of charge per plug type

tools.name: kia_start_climate
tools.description: Start climate preconditioning (confirmation-gated, KIA_WRITE_MODE comfort or all)

tools.name: kia_stop_climate
tools.description: Stop climate preconditioning (confirmation-gated, KIA_WRITE_MODE comfort or all)

tools.name: kia_start_charge
tools.description: Start charging a plugged-in EV (confirmation-gated, KIA_WRITE_MODE comfort or all)

tools.name: kia_stop_charge
tools.description: Stop EV charging (confirmation-gated, KIA_WRITE_MODE comfort or all)

tools.name: kia_set_charge_limits
tools.description: Set the EV target state of charge per plug type (confirmation-gated, KIA_WRITE_MODE comfort or all)

tools.name: kia_lock_doors
tools.description: Lock the vehicle's doors (confirmation-gated, KIA_WRITE_MODE all only)

tools.name: kia_unlock_doors
tools.description: Unlock the vehicle's doors (confirmation-gated, KIA_WRITE_MODE all only)

kia_username.title: Kia account email
kia_username.description: The email address you sign in to Kia Access / the Kia Owners Portal with.

kia_password.title: Kia account password
kia_password.description: Your Kia account password. Stored by the host, sent only to Kia's login endpoint.

kia_write_mode.title: Vehicle command mode
kia_write_mode.description: "none" disables all vehicle commands; "comfort" allows climate and charging; "all" also allows door lock/unlock.
